_comment: Committed description of downloadable weights. The files themselves are git-ignored. Keep the licence field honest: code licence and weight licence are separate questions. See docs/THIRD_PARTY.md. sha256 is of the downloaded object (the zip archive or the bare file, see sha256_of), measured 2026-09-21; null means unpinned.

fishial_detector_v26.description: Fishial.ai fish detector, YOLO26 nano, 640px. Best default for real aquarium footage.
fishial_detector_v26.weights_license: Not separately stated by the publisher; trained with ultralytics (AGPL-3.0). Treat as bootstrap-only until clarified.

fishial_detector_v10_m.description: Fishial.ai fish detector, YOLOv10 medium. Heavier, older.
fishial_detector_v10_m.weights_license: Not separately stated by the publisher; trained with ultralytics (AGPL-3.0). Treat as bootstrap-only until clarified.

yolov8n_coco.description: Generic COCO YOLOv8 nano. Has NO fish class; useful only to prove the adapter works or as a fine-tuning starting point.
yolov8n_coco.weights_license: AGPL-3.0 (ultralytics states weights are covered by the same licence)
